My duster experiance.
Ok so my time on duster.  First I start by getting sorta light headed, followed by the initial doeses.  It starts off by kinda feeling numb in my fingers and toes.  Then it hits me like a bus.  My hearing comes in and out, my sight sometimes comes in odd shapes like a pin wheel or circle.  Then Tiny red, blue, and green dots flood my vision.  My legs and arms contrace and I get a huge smile on my face.  I laugh uncontralbly and this is all in a few seconds.  The whole of the eperiance lasts about 30 or so seconds.
I always hold the can straight up and down, build a tolerance, wait 5-10 minutes per trip, and never, never ,never hold the can upside down.  I would give this drug a 9 out of 10.
